I answered Tobias in a thread under his message in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 2026-06-09 and said the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to that ticket. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so he could see it himself.

I also passed on Hollis's warning from that thread. The import file labels doors E1/E2 but the booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs fixing before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates.
